# War Scroll Column 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** complete

---

**5:1** The horsemen [...] on the right and on the left of the battle line. They shall place on both sides of the battle line horsemen. Their horsemen shall number six thousand —

**5:2** five hundred to each tribe. And the horsemen who go forth with the infantry to battle: their riders shall be men of valor, between thirty and forty-five years of age.

**5:3** And the horsemen upon the mounts: their age shall be between forty and fifty years of age. And they and their mounts shall wear coats of armor, helmets, and greaves,

**5:4** and they shall hold in their hands round shields, a spear eight cubits in length, a bow and arrows, and a war dagger.

**5:5** And all of them shall be united in purpose to slay those slain by God. And the cavalry of the warriors shall be stationed beside the bulls of

**5:6** the burnt offering — twelve in number. And the chiefs of [...] shall be beside the bulls at all times. And the rule of the cavalry: they shall select from all the tribes of Israel

**5:7** men of valor for the cavalry, and they shall prepare for them horses that are swift of foot, gentle of mouth, long of wind, and mature in years,

**5:8** trained runners, with men who know how to ride them. Their age: from thirty to forty-five years of age. And the horsemen of the line shall be between

**5:9** forty and fifty years of age. And they [...] the saddle cloths. And their horses shall be covered with coats of

**5:10** mail, with helmets and greaves on their legs. And they shall carry shields [...] and a lance eight cubits long. And the bow

**5:11** and arrows and the war dagger shall be girded on their waists. And all these shall ride upon the mares [...] when the lot falls to them. And no

**5:12** one who is lame or blind or crippled, no man with a permanent blemish on his flesh, or a man afflicted with a bodily impurity —

**5:13** all these shall not go forth with them to war. All of them shall be warriors, volunteers, sound in spirit and body. And the holy

**5:14** angels shall be with their armies. And no youth shall be among them on the day of battle, for the holy angels are with them

**5:15** together. And a space shall be between all their camps and the latrine, about two thousand cubits, and no

**5:16** indecent nakedness shall be seen in the surroundings of all their camps. And the officers of the camps shall be between

**5:17** forty and fifty years of age, and those who arrange the camps, their equipment, and all their provisions [...] shall be men of understanding.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 5 details cavalry regulations including age requirements, weaponry (spears, bows, daggers, shields), and horse selection criteria. The fourfold description of ideal horses (swift, gentle-mouthed, long-winded, mature) shows practical military knowledge. Purity requirements (5:12-15) parallel 2:4-7 and reflect Deut 23:10-15, adapted for eschatological warfare. The presence of holy angels demands ritual purity.*
